title: Outbound webhooks
description: Checks that your app sends webhooks: each case registers this run's capture URL ({{webhook.url}}) as a subscriber, performs an action over your API, then waits for the delivery and asserts on its JSON body. The paths of the payload fields (event, id, data.id) are fixed in the steps; edit them if your payload is shaped differently. Not covered: signature headers (e.g. an HMAC X-Signature) — wait-for-webhook matches on method, path and JSON body only, and captured credential headers are redacted. The app must be able to reach TraceIQ's public URL.

variables.name: APP_API_BASE
variables.description: Base URL of your app's API, without a trailing slash.

variables.name: APP_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Bearer token for your API. Stored as a project secret.

variables.name: WEBHOOK_REGISTER_PATH
variables.description: Endpoint that registers a webhook subscriber (POST {url, events}).

variables.name: WEBHOOK_EVENT
variables.description: Event name the action should emit; matched against the payload's "event" field.

variables.name: TRIGGER_PATH
variables.description: Endpoint whose POST performs the action (its JSON response must carry the new object's "id").

variables.name: TRIGGER_BODY
variables.description: JSON body sent to the trigger endpoint.

suites.name: Outbound webhooks
suites.description: Delivery, payload contents and subscriber-registration auth.

cases.name: Action triggers a webhook delivery
cases.description: After the trigger call, a POST arrives at the capture URL whose body has event = WEBHOOK_EVENT.

cases.name: Webhook payload identifies the object and the delivery
cases.description: The delivery's data.id equals the id the trigger call returned, and the payload carries its own delivery id.

cases.name: Registering a subscriber requires authentication
cases.description: POST to the registration endpoint without a token answers 401, so nobody can point your webhooks elsewhere.
